data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter widget for paginated lists, grids, and slivers with pull-to-refresh.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that handles pagination, infinite scrolling, pull-to-refresh, item deduplication, and loading/error/empty states for lists, grids, and slivers. It separates data handling via a delegate from presentation configuration via an options class, while letting developers retain control over state management.
use_when: You need paginated lists or grids with infinite scrolling and pull-to-refresh.
You want built-in handling for empty, error, and loading states without writing boilerplate scroll listeners.
avoid_when: You are not using pagination and simply need a standard, small static list or grid.
You prefer an entirely custom low-level scroll listener implementation.
strengths: Supports box and sliver layouts for ListView and GridView.
Built-in support for pull-to-refresh, deduplication, and tunable load-more thresholds.
State management agnostic (works with BLoC, Riverpod, Provider, or setState).
weaknesses: Requires adherence to its specific delegate and status lifecycle contract.
Box-based views render eagerly inside a single scrollable unless using the sliver-based variant.
